steps.name: environment
steps.description: Install and verify required system packages: python3-venv, python3-tk and ensure python3-pip is available. Install xvfb only when no usable X server/socket is detected. Perform smoke checks: python3 -m pip --version and python3 -c 'import tkinter' to validate system bindings. Fail fast with clear exit codes on missing prerequisites.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WS="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/simple-desktop-clock-279729-279738/tkinter_native_app"
# Install minimal system packages and verify; do not silence apt failures
sudo apt-get update -q && sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y python3-venv python3-tk python3-pip
# Verify python3 -m pip is functional
if ! python3 -m pip --version >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "error: system python3-pip missing or unusable" >&2
  exit 11
fi
# If no X socket and no X process, install xvfb; otherwise rely on existing DISPLAY/VNC
if [ ! -e /tmp/.X11-unix ] && ! pgrep -f "(X|Xorg|Xwayland|Xvfb)" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y xvfb
fi
# Smoke-check tkinter import using system python (will fail early if system package missing)
if ! python3 - <<PYCODE
try:
    import tkinter
except Exception as e:
    import sys
    print('error: system tkinter import failed:', e, file=sys.stderr)
    sys.exit(12)
sys.exit(0)
PYCODE
then
  exit 12
fi
# Quick X availability check: either DISPLAY set and socket exists, or socket exists
if [ -n "${DISPLAY-}" ]; then
  if [ ! -e /tmp/.X11-unix ] && ! pgrep -f "(X|Xorg|Xwayland|Xvfb)" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "warning: DISPLAY is set but no X server socket or process detected" >&2
  fi
else
  if [ ! -e /tmp/.X11-unix ] && ! pgrep -f "(X|Xorg|Xwayland|Xvfb)" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    echo "error: no X server available (and DISPLAY unset)" >&2
    exit 13
  fi
fi

steps.name: scaffolding
steps.description: Create workspace directory, initialize a Python venv at .venv if missing, ensure pip is present in the venv (attempt ensurepip fallback), create requirements.txt if absent, and generate start.sh that invokes the venv's python binary directly. Do not alter global environment files. Operates in the authoritative workspace.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WS="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/simple-desktop-clock-279729-279738/tkinter_native_app"
mkdir -p "$WS" && cd "$WS"
# Create venv if missing
if [ ! -d ".venv" ]; then
  python3 -m venv .venv
fi
# Ensure pip exists in venv; attempt to bootstrap if missing
if [ ! -x ".venv/bin/pip" ]; then
  if [ -x ".venv/bin/python" ]; then
    .venv/bin/python -m ensurepip --upgrade || true
  fi
fi
[ -x ".venv/bin/pip" ] || { echo "error: venv pip missing" >&2; exit 21; }
# Ensure requirements.txt exists (empty if project has none)
if [ ! -f requirements.txt ]; then
  : > requirements.txt
fi
# Write start.sh to exec the venv python directly (avoids activation fragility)
cat > start.sh <<'SH'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
DIR=$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)
PY="$DIR/.venv/bin/python"
[ -x "$PY" ] || { echo "error: venv python missing" >&2; exit 22; }
# Prefer existing DISPLAY; default to :99 if unset
: "${DISPLAY:=:99}"
export DISPLAY
# Prefer clock.py then main.py
if [ -f "$DIR/clock.py" ]; then
  exec "$PY" "$DIR/clock.py"
elif [ -f "$DIR/main.py" ]; then
  exec "$PY" "$DIR/main.py"
else
  echo 'error: No clock.py or main.py found in workspace' >&2
  exit 23
fi
SH
chmod +x start.sh

steps.name: start
steps.description: Start the Tkinter application from the workspace using start.sh. Use setsid to decouple the process, wait for the PID to become the expected python executable (verify via /proc/<pid>/cmdline), write the pidfile after verification, and register traps to clean up on unexpected exit. This ensures deterministic PID mapping and avoids races.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WS="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/simple-desktop-clock-279729-279738/tkinter_native_app"
cd "$WS"
[ -x "$WS/start.sh" ] || { echo "error: start.sh missing or not executable" >&2; exit 50; }
PIDFILE="$WS/app.pid"
# Start via setsid and background, capture PID
setsid "$WS"/start.sh >/dev/null 2>&1 &
LAUNCH_PID=$!
APP_PID=$LAUNCH_PID
# wait up to ~10s for the process to exist and verify it's a python process
TRIES=0
while [ $TRIES -lt 10 ]; do
  if ps -p "$APP_PID" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    # verify cmdline contains the venv python path
    if [ -r "/proc/$APP_PID/cmdline" ]; then
      CMDLINE=$(tr '\0' ' ' < "/proc/$APP_PID/cmdline" || true)
      if echo "$CMDLINE" | grep -q ".venv/bin/python"; then
        echo "$APP_PID" > "$PIDFILE"
        # ensure cleanup on exit if invoked interactively
        trap 'kill "$APP_PID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true' EXIT
        exit 0
      fi
    fi
    # if not yet the expected exec, wait a bit
  fi
  TRIES=$((TRIES+1))
  sleep 1
done
# If we reach here, startup didn't result in expected python exec
# attempt to read any existing pid and report
if ps -p "$APP_PID" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "error: started process did not appear to exec venv python (cmdline mismatch)" >&2
else
  echo "error: app failed to start" >&2
fi
exit 51

steps.name: validation
steps.description: Validate environment end-to-end: invoke the canonical start step, confirm the running process is the venv python via pidfile, run tests (if present) using venv pytest and propagate failures, then stop the app cleanly. Uses traps to ensure cleanup and consistent start/stop behavior.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WS="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/simple-desktop-clock-279729-279738/tkinter_native_app"
cd "$WS"
PIDFILE="$WS/app.pid"
# Ensure app is started via canonical start step
if [ ! -f "$PIDFILE" ]; then
  # call start script (which uses setsid and writes pidfile after verification)
  "$WS"/start >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  # wait briefly for pidfile
  TRIES=0
  while [ $TRIES -lt 10 ] && [ ! -f "$PIDFILE" ]; do
    sleep 1
    TRIES=$((TRIES+1))
  done
fi
if [ ! -f "$PIDFILE" ]; then
  echo "error: pidfile missing after start" >&2
  exit 60
fi
APP_PID=$(cat "$PIDFILE")
# Verify process running and is venv python
if ! ps -p "$APP_PID" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "error: app process $APP_PID not running" >&2
  exit 61
fi
if [ -r "/proc/$APP_PID/cmdline" ]; then
  CMDLINE=$(tr '\0' ' ' < "/proc/$APP_PID/cmdline" || true)
  if ! echo "$CMDLINE" | grep -q ".venv/bin/python"; then
    echo "error: running process does not appear to be venv python: $CMDLINE" >&2
    # continue to tests attempt but mark failure
    START_OK=0
  else
    START_OK=1
  fi
else
  START_OK=0
fi
# Run tests if pytest present
PYTEST_BIN="$WS/.venv/bin/pytest"
if [ -x "$PYTEST_BIN" ]; then
  "$PYTEST_BIN" -q --maxfail=1 || { TEST_RC=$?; echo "error: tests failed (rc=$TEST_RC)" >&2; 
    kill "$APP_PID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; sleep 1; kill -9 "$APP_PID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; rm -f "$PIDFILE" || true; exit $TEST_RC; }
fi
# Stop the app gracefully
kill "$APP_PID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
sleep 1
if ps -p "$APP_PID" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  kill -9 "$APP_PID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
fi
rm -f "$PIDFILE" || true
if [ "$START_OK" -ne 1 ]; then
  echo "warning: start verification incomplete; see earlier messages" >&2
fi
echo "validation_complete"

exit 52

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WS="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/simple-desktop-clock-279729-279738/tkinter_native_app"
cd "$WS"
PIDFILE="$WS/app.pid"
# invoke canonical start
if [ ! -f "$PIDFILE" ]; then
  "$WS"/start >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  TRIES=0
  while [ $TRIES -lt 10 ] && [ ! -f "$PIDFILE" ]; do
    sleep 1
    TRIES=$((TRIES+1))
  done
fi
if [ ! -f "$PIDFILE" ]; then
  echo "error: pidfile missing after start" >&2
  exit 60
fi
APP_PID=$(cat "$PIDFILE")
if ! ps -p "$APP_PID" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "error: app process $APP_PID not running" >&2
  exit 61
fi
START_OK=0
if [ -r "/proc/$APP_PID/cmdline" ]; then
  CMDLINE=$(tr '\0' ' ' < "/proc/$APP_PID/cmdline" || true)
  if echo "$CMDLINE" | grep -q ".venv/bin/python"; then
    START_OK=1
  else
    echo "error: running process does not appear to be venv python: $CMDLINE" >&2
    START_OK=0
  fi
else
  START_OK=0
fi
# Run tests if pytest present
PYTEST_BIN="$WS/.venv/bin/pytest"
if [ -x "$PYTEST_BIN" ]; then
  "$PYTEST_BIN" -q --maxfail=1 || { TEST_RC=$?; echo "error: tests failed (rc=$TEST_RC)" >&2; 
    kill "$APP_PID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; sleep 1; kill -9 "$APP_PID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; rm -f "$PIDFILE" || true; exit $TEST_RC; }
fi
# Stop the app gracefully
kill "$APP_PID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
sleep 1
if ps -p "$APP_PID" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  kill -9 "$APP_PID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
fi
rm -f "$PIDFILE" || true
if [ "$START_OK" -ne 1 ]; then
  echo "warning: start verification incomplete; see earlier messages" >&2
fi
echo "validation_complete"
